data.what_it_does: Displays animated waveform bars from a stream of amplitude data. It can be customized in color, height, and animation.
use_when: Adding animated waveforms to existing widgets
avoid_when: When you need audio playback or recording
When you need a full audio processing pipeline
strengths: Easy to integrate via a single widget
Built on Flutter streams for real‑time updates
weaknesses: Does not provide audio source or playback
Requires an external package (e.g., record) for live audio
data.setup_notes: Add `waveform_flutter: ^1.2.0` to pubspec, import the package, and provide a Stream<Amplitude> to AnimatedWaveList
